title: BC Friday Tips #65 Freeze Column Property
summary: The FreezeColumn property keeps selected columns visible when users scroll horizontally through list pages with many fields, reducing the need for horizontal scrolling and keeping important data in view.
key_points: FreezeColumn property prevents selected columns from scrolling out of view horizontally
Particularly useful for list pages that display many fields
Improves user experience by keeping important columns visible at all times
Can be added to list page definitions

quotes.text: FreezeColumn keeps selected columns visible while users scroll horizontally.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core functionality that explains what the feature does and its primary benefit

quotes.text: It works great for lists with many fields.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the specific use case where this feature is most valuable
